title: Insurance intake workflow v1
description: Build the internal insurance intake workflow: employee mobile uploads, adapter-based backend services, durable parsing, admin verification, and secure provider sharing.
design: Use vendor-neutral ports for AuthProvider, CaseRepository, ObjectStorage, DocumentParser, WorkflowRunner, AuditLog, Clock, and IdGenerator. V1 adapters are Clerk, Neon Postgres, S3, Gemini, and Vercel Workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc is updated; child tasks cover architecture, adapters, workflow, UI, security, and tests.

title: Insurance: build provider shared-link page
description: Add finalization, secure token links, revocation, expiry, provider-safe field rendering, and document visibility enforcement.
design: Provider page should be public token access, no Clerk login. Store only token hashes. Show verified data only, mask Aadhaar by default, and expose only documents with shareExternally enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create/revoke links; valid links show finalized fields and selected docs; expired/revoked links are rejected; Aadhaar masking/full-sharing rules are enforced.

title: Insurance: add audit logging and PII safeguards
description: Add audit events and privacy controls around uploads, parsing, verification, finalization, shared links, and provider views.
design: Use AuditLog port throughout domain services. Avoid logging Aadhaar numbers, raw document content, signed URLs, or tokens. Add default masking and document-sharing policy checks.
acceptance_criteria: Important state transitions and provider views write audit events; logs do not contain sensitive values; tests cover masked Aadhaar and document sharing defaults.

title: Insurance: add workflow test fixtures and acceptance checks
description: Add tests and fixtures that prove the insurance workflow works through ports and can use fake adapters.
design: Cover auth role checks, upload registration, parse success/failure, verification/finalization, shared-link access, expiry/revocation, Aadhaar masking, and adapter isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Tests can run without real Clerk/S3/Gemini/Vercel dependencies by using fake adapters; npm run build passes; critical CUJs from the design doc are covered.

title: Insurance: define domain ports and shared types
description: Create the vendor-neutral contracts and domain types for the insurance workflow before adding any concrete provider implementation.
design: Define ports for AuthProvider, CaseRepository, ObjectStorage, DocumentParser, WorkflowRunner, AuditLog, Clock, and IdGenerator. Define shared case/document/extraction/share-link types and parser field template.
acceptance_criteria: No route handler or domain service imports vendor SDKs directly; fake in-memory adapters can satisfy the interfaces in tests.

title: Insurance: add Neon schema and CaseRepository adapter
description: Add the Postgres schema and repository implementation for cases, documents, extractions, parse runs, share links, and audit records.
design: Implement the CaseRepository port against Neon Postgres. Keep SQL/ORM details inside the adapter and expose only domain types to services.
acceptance_criteria: Schema supports the v1 design doc entities; repository methods are covered by tests or integration checks; domain services do not import Neon/ORM clients.

title: Insurance: add Clerk AuthProvider adapter and role gates
description: Integrate Clerk for employee/admin auth while keeping application code behind the AuthProvider/Authz port.
design: Map Clerk users/session claims to internal Actor and Role types. Add route-level guards for employee upload and admin verification/finalization.
acceptance_criteria: Employee/admin role checks work through the AuthProvider port; non-admin users cannot access verification/finalization APIs; core services do not import Clerk SDKs.

title: Insurance: add ObjectStorage adapter and upload registration
description: Implement private document storage behind the ObjectStorage port and support mobile direct uploads.
design: V1 adapter is S3. Expose presigned upload URLs, private reads for parsing, and provider-safe short-lived read URLs. Persist only object locations/metadata in the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Employee upload flow can register Aadhaar/purchase-slip files; unsupported MIME/oversized files are rejected; routes do not expose raw bucket keys or import S3 SDKs outside the adapter.

title: Insurance: add DocumentParser adapter for Gemini
description: Implement structured document extraction behind the DocumentParser port using Gemini vision for v1.
design: Parser input should use object bytes/metadata supplied by ObjectStorage, not storage SDK clients. Parser output should validate against the fixed generic purchase-insurance field template and return missing/confidence metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Gemini SDK imports are isolated to the adapter; parser returns normalized data or typed parse errors; invalid model output is persisted as parse failure metadata.

title: Insurance: add WorkflowRunner adapter and parse workflow
description: Use Vercel Workflows as the v1 durable execution adapter for parsing, while keeping domain services behind WorkflowRunner.
design: Workflow state should contain only caseId/parseRunId. The workflow should load metadata through CaseRepository, read docs through ObjectStorage, parse through DocumentParser, save extraction, and mark parse success/failure.
acceptance_criteria: Upload completion and reparse start parse runs through WorkflowRunner; workflow is idempotent; replacing Vercel Workflows would not require route/domain service changes.

title: Insurance: build employee mobile upload flow
description: Add a phone-friendly employee flow for creating insurance cases and uploading Aadhaar/purchase-slip documents.
design: Use the existing Next/Ant patterns. Client should call create case, request upload URLs, upload files directly, then complete upload to start parsing.
acceptance_criteria: Employees can create a case from mobile, upload required docs, see upload progress/errors, and land on a submitted/parsing state.

title: Insurance: build admin queue and verification UI
description: Add admin screens for parse status triage, document review, editing extracted fields, verification, reparse, and rejection.
design: Use existing Ant/refine layout patterns. Verification page should compare source document previews with editable verified fields and preserve raw extraction separately.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can filter/review cases, edit verified data, mark verified, re-run parse, reject bad cases, and see parse errors/missing fields.
